# 1. Packages and data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
select <- dplyr::select

corres <- read.csv("4.traits_per_morphogroups/input/corres_species_morphogroups.csv",sep=";") %>% 
  select(species_name,corres_morphogroup) %>% 
  rename(species_coleo=species_name,
         morphog =corres_morphogroup)

ab_coleo <- read.csv("4.traits_per_morphogroups/input/ab_coleo_sp.csv") %>% 
  select(-X) %>% 
  left_join(corres) %>% 
  group_by(morphog) %>% 
  mutate(somme=sum(ab)) 
  

traits <-  read.csv("4.traits_per_morphogroups/input/bdd_traits_coleo.csv",sep=";") %>% 
  select(4,24,33,44,52) %>% 
   rename(diet_imagos=Regime.alimentaire.des.imagos,
         diet_larvae=Regime.alimentaire.des.larves,
         flower_visitor=Visiteur.floral,
         pest=Ravageur)
  
```

# 2. Recode traits

## 2.1. Manage NA

```{r}
traits_na <- traits %>% 
  mutate(diet_larvae = if_else(is.na(diet_larvae), "inconnu_diet_larvae", diet_larvae)) %>% 
  mutate(diet_larvae = if_else(diet_larvae=="", "inconnu_diet_larvae_", diet_larvae))%>% 
  mutate(diet_imagos = if_else(is.na(diet_imagos), "inconnu_diet_imagos_", diet_imagos)) %>% 
  mutate(diet_imagos = if_else(diet_imagos=="", "inconnu_diet_imagos_", diet_imagos)) %>% 
   mutate(flower_visitor = if_else(is.na(flower_visitor), "Non", flower_visitor)) %>% 
  mutate(flower_visitor = if_else(flower_visitor=="", "Non", flower_visitor)) %>% 
  mutate(pest = if_else(is.na(pest), "Non", pest)) %>% 
  mutate(pest = if_else(pest=="", "Non", pest)) 
```

## 2.2. Simplify traits

```{r}
traits_clean <- traits_na %>% 
    mutate(diet_larvae = 
             ifelse(diet_larvae=="Zoophage"|diet_larvae=="Omnivore","predator",
              ifelse(diet_larvae=="inconnu_diet_larvae","NA",
              ifelse(diet_larvae=="Parasite","parasite","phytophage")))) %>% 
    mutate(diet_imagos =   ifelse(diet_imagos=="Zoophage"|diet_imagos=="Omnivore","predator",
              ifelse(diet_imagos=="inconnu_diet_larvae","NA","phytophage"))) %>% 
  mutate(predator = 
           ifelse(diet_imagos=="predator"|diet_larvae=="predator","predator","not_predator")) %>% 
  mutate(flower_visitor = ifelse(flower_visitor=="Non","not_flower_visitor","flower_visitor")) %>%
    mutate(pest = ifelse(pest=="Ravageur objet de lutte","pest","not_pest")) %>% 
  select(species_coleo,predator,pest,flower_visitor)
```

--\> after discussion with beetle experts (Julien Haran, Gael Kergoat, Axel Bourdonné) if a beetle is in the category "May cause damages" I do not consider it as a pest and if a flower visitor "rarely" visits flowers I do consider it as a flower visitor.

## 2.3. Rename "Divers petits avec antennes en massue"

```{r}
fam <-  read.csv("4.traits_per_morphogroups/input/corres_species_morphogroups.csv",sep=";") %>% 
  select(species_name,family) %>% 
  rename(species_coleo=species_name)

divers_petits <- read.csv("4.traits_per_morphogroups/input/ab_coleo_sp.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>% 
  left_join(corres) %>% 
  group_by(morphog) %>% 
  mutate(somme=sum(ab)) %>% 
  filter(somme==6263) %>% 
  left_join(fam) %>% 
  group_by(family) %>% 
  summarise(somme_fam = sum(ab)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(somme_tot=6263,
         pourc_fam = somme_fam/ somme_tot) 
```

More than 80% of the Divers petits group are Nitidulidae, and more than 77% are Brassicogethes aeneus. This group will be renamed

# 3. Add traits and morphogroup information to abundance data

```{r}
ab_data <- ab_coleo %>% 
  left_join(corres) %>% 
  left_join(traits_clean)%>% 
  mutate(morphog= recode(morphog,
                         "Bruches" = "Seed_beetles",
                         "Buprestes"="Jewel_beetles",
                         "Cantharides"="Soldier_beetles",
                         "Carabiques"="Ground_beetles",
                         "Charancons"="Weevils",
                         "Chrysomeles"="Leaf_beetles",
                         "Coccinelles"="Ladybugs",                      "Divers-_Petits_coleopteres_avec_antennes_en_massues" ="Sap_beetles",
                         "Elaterides"="Click_beetles",
                         "Longicornes"="Longhorn_beetles",
                         "Malachites"="Soft_wing_flower_beetles",
                         "Mordelles"="Tumbling_flower_beetles",
                         "Oedemerides"="False_blister_beetles",
                         "Staphylins"="Rove_beetles"
                         )
         )%>% 
  filter(morphog!="Divers")

occ_data <- ab_coleo %>% 
  mutate(occ = 1) %>% 
  select(-ab) %>% 
  left_join(corres) %>% 
  left_join(traits_clean) %>% 
  mutate(morphog= recode(morphog,
                         "Bruches" = "Seed_beetles",
                         "Buprestes"="Jewel_beetles",
                         "Cantharides"="Soldier_beetles",
                         "Carabiques"="Ground_beetles",
                         "Charancons"="Weevils",
                         "Chrysomeles"="Leaf_beetles",
                         "Coccinelles"="Ladybugs",                      "Divers-_Petits_coleopteres_avec_antennes_en_massues" ="Sap_beetles",
                         "Elaterides"="Click_beetles",
                         "Longicornes"="Longhorn_beetles",
                         "Malachites"="Soft_wing_flower_beetles",
                         "Mordelles"="Tumbling_flower_beetles",
                         "Oedemerides"="False_blister_beetles",
                         "Staphylins"="Rove_beetles"
                         )
         )%>% 
  filter(morphog!="Divers")
```

# 4. Categories per morphogroup

## 4.1. Abundance

### 4.1.1. Trophic groups

```{r}
predator_ab <- ab_data %>% 
  group_by(morphog,predator) %>% 
  summarise(ab_groups=sum(ab)) %>% 
  drop_na()   %>% 
  mutate(
    total_ab = sum(ab_groups),
    pct = ab_groups / total_ab * 100)


morphog_pred <-  predator_ab %>% 
  select(-ab_groups,-total_ab) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = predator,
              values_from = pct,
              values_fill = 0)
    
```

### 4.1.2. Pests

```{r}
pest_ab <- ab_data %>% 
  group_by(morphog,pest) %>% 
  summarise(ab_groups=sum(ab)) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    total_ab = sum(ab_groups),
    pct = ab_groups / total_ab * 100
  )

morphog_pest <-  pest_ab %>% 
  select(-ab_groups,-total_ab) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = pest,
              values_from = pct,
              values_fill = 0)
```

### 4.1.3. Flower visitors

```{r}
flovis_ab <- ab_data %>% 
  group_by(morphog,flower_visitor) %>% 
  summarise(ab_groups=sum(ab)) %>% 
  drop_na()%>% 
  mutate(
    total_ab = sum(ab_groups),
    pct = ab_groups / total_ab * 100
  )

morphog_flovis <-  flovis_ab %>% 
  select(-ab_groups,-total_ab) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = flower_visitor,
              values_from = pct,
              values_fill = 0)
```

# 5. Figures

```{r}
ggplot(predator_ab, aes(x = "", y = pct, fill = predator)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("green4","firebrick4"))+
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ morphog, ncol=4) +
   labs(
    fill = "Trophic regime",
    y = "Abundance",
    x = NULL,
    title = "Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
```

# 6. Create traits morphog dataset

```{r}
summary(morphog_flovis)
summary(morphog_pest)
summary(morphog_pred)


morphog_ab_tr <- morphog_flovis %>% 
  left_join(morphog_pest) %>% 
  left_join(morphog_pred) %>% 
  mutate(
    morphog_pred = if_else(predator>75,"predat",
    if_else(predator<25,"not_predator","mixed_pred")),
        morphog_pest = if_else(pest>20,"mostly_pest",
    if_else(pest<10,"not_pest","mostly_not_pest")),
        morphog_flovis = if_else(flower_visitor>75,"flovis",
    if_else(flower_visitor<25,"not_flovis","mixed_flovis"))
    ) 

#write.csv(morphog_ab_tr,"4.traits_per_morphogroups/output/trait_status_morphog.csv")
```
